fields.note: 011 had no separate joint mass. This card sets joint mass to 5 percent of tube mass and reduces the tube budget so film, nodes, joints, systems and tube still equal the lift mass. The 5 percent is the P2 sandwich fraction applied to tubes, not a measured fitting. RESULTS carries a 6061 scan with the joint term removed. Node mass remains 0.02 kg times V(s).
